warnings: Column details are drawn per height range (one cross-section per range); one entry per mark per range with the printed range in `level` (§8). Ranges differ between marks (C3 changes at พื้นชั้น 2, the others at พื้นชั้น 3) — recorded as printed.

Bar symbols: this set's legend (printed on sheet 5 beside the footing details) reads '⊕ — เหล็กข้ออ้อย, ø — เหล็กกลม' — the hatched/crossed circle used for every main bar is the deformed-bar symbol, so main bars are type DB; the plain ø used for every stirrup/slab bar is RB. No steel grade or fy is printed anywhere in the set.
C1 upper range prints '2-⊕16 มม.' and '4-⊕16 มม.' on two leaders (6 bars: 4 corners + 2 at mid-width) — recorded as one count of 6; the lower two ranges print 6-⊕16 directly.

F1 is a deep single-pile cap 0.70 x 0.70 x 0.70 reinforced as a cage — 8-⊕16 vertical bars plus 4-ø9 horizontal ties — not a bottom mat; main_bar carries the vertical bars, stirrup the 4 ties (count, no spacing printed).

F2 (two piles at 1.00) prints two 9-⊕16 lines; the qualifier on the first reads '(ล่าง) ยาว 10/4' and on the second is illegible. Read as a two-way bottom mat 9+9 (one dot row along the long section + the long bar), flagged.
Both footings: concrete 1:2:4, lean concrete 1:3:5, compacted coarse sand; piles 0.22 x 0.22 prestressed, 21.00 m (see the notes view for the TIS standards).
